rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday shorthand for antivirus software, especially after verbs such as 裝 or 更新.

example.english: I installed antivirus on my computer, so I feel much more at ease.
example.traditional: 我部電腦裝咗防毒，安心好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 zong1 zo2 fong4 duk6 on1 sam1 hou2 do1
